reading: GRÜN development reading · A-G91 option (3) costed — the fits/shelved boundary without a shelf ring

zeroByConstructionChannel.name: repeat-capture difference over DISC pixels on a static field (reducedMotion:reduce)
zeroByConstructionChannel.domain: disc only — the host animates outside it, so a whole-region form is not zero and would false-alarm

definitions.conditionPersistence: each condition is threaded through every mask build via unhideAll(page, keep). Without it the first unhideAll inside signAndSeatMask strips the condition and all three conditions measure the same field — which is what the first version of this probe did, and only the per-body occupancies were wrong.

conditions.B_ringHidden: ring not drawn, its opaque black seat kept
conditions.C_ringAndSeatHidden: ring and its seat both gone

definitions.boundaryStep: median luminance over 360 angles just INSIDE the boundary (420 units) against just outside it in the shelf band (445 units); the fits/shelved radius is 430
definitions.whatAlreadyCarriesTheBoundary: the MEDIUM already terminates at shelfNear by construction: mf-ground r = shelfNear (:855/:890), all seven wave layers r = shelfNear (:859/:892), the territory wash spans personRadius…shelfNear (:894), and mf-rest steps to SEAT at shelfNear/fieldRadius + 0.001 (:867). The lit, breathing medium ENDS at the boundary — so option (3) needs no new carrier, it needs the ring removed.
definitions.libCareerCost: ZERO. rings.shelfNear/shelfFar appear in lib/career only in fitDistance (layout.ts:48) and the band rule (layout.ts:102), and in the view model's geometry passthrough — the RADIUS, never the drawn ring. No layout maths, no golden vector and no spec value changes.
definitions.testCost: NOT zero, and gated: field-f.test.tsx:114 iterates all four ring testids asserting each has a seat beneath it, so it must become three. field-e.test.tsx:328 already skips the shelf. neurovisual-e.test.ts:84 asserts best/shelf >= 1.6 on the CONSTANT, so it survives if RING_LUMINANCE keeps a shelf entry that nothing draws — which would be a lie in the table and should instead be removed with the ring, which that assertion then also needs. So option (3) cannot land without the test-database gate.

boundaryStepRatio.reading: whether the fits/shelved line is still legible as a step in the medium with no ring drawn

costSummary.A_G82_legibilityFloor: dissolves — there is no ring to make legible. The floor was a bound on a rung; option (3) removes the rung and keeps the boundary.
